column5: The complete MySQL byte-unescaping contract is transcreated into the shared lexer leaf and consumed by parser string decoding; all 256 byte inputs retain the exact one-byte or pattern-preserving result shape.

The complete dependency-inversion IHasher method contract is transcreated into the shared hash leaf. HashString accepts arbitrary Go string bytes rather than only valid Rust UTF-8; the planner consumer matches Go range semantics for valid and malformed encodings, while its object-safe facade retains cache methods.
